other_failure_modes.description: The agent creates the submission file by generating a new sequence of IDs from 0 to N-1 instead of using the provided ID column from the test dataset. If the test set IDs are non-sequential or start from a different index, this will result in misaligned predictions or a zero score during evaluation.

summary: The agent correctly avoids test data leakage by fitting its scalers and imputers solely on the training data. However, it completely fails to evaluate its models because it ignores the validation folds it sets up, leaving generalisation unestimated. The solution also lacks feature engineering and relies on naive ensembling, while a critical bug in the submission generation hardcodes the ID column instead of dynamically using the IDs provided in the test set.
